scope: Research-only Blog Authorship Corpus; maker tier remains closed; no age or sex fields read

policy.selection: Minimum average MAE over corpus-only scenarios; smallest tested count with no MAE/top1 loss against raw in either shape at any neutral fraction

pack: No maker admission; voluntary subject return remains unruled

protocol.cohort: Lowest SHA-256 1000 writer IDs with >=40 dated posts >=100 words
protocol.halves: Chronological equal sides; each subdivided into alternating posts
protocol.measurement: Pool sentence predictions in each replicate, exact TP12 correction, then condition on emotion
protocol.subject_control: 20 unsupervised Potion word-vector clusters; earlier-half other-writer cluster means only
protocol.variance: TR1 Spearman-Brown within-side reliability and observed variance times reliability
protocol.stability: Unclipped consecutive-half correlation divided by sqrt(reliabilities); 2000 whole-writer draws, undefined draw invalidates interval
protocol.log_score: Later mix under earlier writer mix versus other-writer earlier population; subject control adjusts historical departure by later subject composition; clipping 1e-6 then renormalizing
protocol.reference: Sounding Line docs/design/stage-15/week5/TR1_BACK_HALF.md; split-half measurement adaptation, no gain model
protocol.bars: After subject control: at least three labels with whole interval >.5 and positive-variance interval; own-history log-score gain interval >0
